title: Exquisite Flaky Portuguese Cod Fritters
description: A winey, flaky, solo-dinner Portuguese dish featuring poppy seeds and bonito-shave, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly meal.
instructions: Rinse the cod fillets under cold water, pat dry with paper towels, and cut into small pieces.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, poppy seeds, bonito flakes, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion, egg, white wine, and olive oil to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Gently fold in the cod pieces until they are evenly coated with the flour mixture.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the mixture into balls and flatten slightly into patties.
Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 350 degrees.
Carefully place the patties in the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters hot, garnished with additional poppy seeds and bonito flakes if desired.
